scope: Bounded composition of retained native PP method CALs with the retained one-through-six-bridge point-to-point route and Reply Network correlation; scripted acceptance only

retained_native_evidence.finding: Retains native direct, paged/NCC, OEM memory, GIU/SGIU/DALI and GOC/GOCBYT/GOC2 programming-method order and block limits.
Original receiver correlation accepts Reply Network paths through one to six bridges and rejects route, unit and CAL mismatches.
Retains the exact-once routed Unlock, STORE acknowledgement and complete readback composition.

cmqttd_acceptance: Transport tests pin one- and six-bridge selector, page, tagged STORE and recall bytes for OEM, GOC2 and page-aware methods.
Direct, neighbouring-route, wrong-unit, wrong-parameter and wrong-tag replies cannot advance routed OEM programming.
Every stateful selector and STORE is issued once; incomplete correlation retires the programming generation without replay.
The C-Gate service test executes a page-aware routed PP SAVE and commits only the owned target-network session after verified readback.
CMQTT CAPABILITIES exposes every admitted routed method and routed Save-to-NVM completion boundary.
evidence_boundaries: No live bridge or routed unit was modified for this acceptance.
Successful protocol acknowledgement and readback do not establish power-cycle persistence or every device-family firmware behavior.
Routed C-Bus 3 Save-to-NVM extended-CAL composition is covered by native_cgate_routed_nvm_commit.json; live bridge delivery and power-cycle durability remain unverified.

native_method_limits.source: C-Gate 3.4.0.2001 lP static arrays N/P, save loop and read planner; L, aU, bm, bn, bo and ct request/reply classes (owned CFR 0.152 output)
native_method_limits.page_boundary: Save groups end where the logical address is a multiple of 256; paged reads never cross a page.
native_method_limits.store_tag: Save-loop group index (n2 & 0xFF); OEM stores use fixed data tag 0x42.
native_method_limits.paged_fragment_parameter: L accepts a reply fragment only when its parameter is the start parameter plus bytes already received.
native_method_limits.protection_save_rule: Classes 0, 2 and 14 use the tagged ct STORE; class 3 sends dd UNLOCK first; classes 4 and 5 are skipped.

method_brackets.giu: bm run flag FC tag 03 value 00 before the first GIU STORE and value 01 after the save
method_brackets.dali: one-second sleep before the first DALI STORE

native_method_limits.native_observation: research/verify_network.py --fixture key4 --backend local (2026-09-29): native PP LOAD recalled 1A2A0C for the six-byte UnitName and SAVE sent one six-byte STORE A82A00...
cmqttd_acceptance: Transport tests direct_pp_recall_splits_at_native_twelve_byte_limit, paged_method_recall_uses_native_limits_and_advancing_fragments and oem_method_recall_reselects_each_native_twelve_byte_block pin the request sizes.
Service test physical_pp_save_writes_factory_bit_like_native_class_fourteen pins the class-14 STORE.

toolkit-cli/tests/test_cmqtt_programming_methods_interop.py derives complete CLI-to-cmqttd transcripts from these limits for all ten methods locally and through one or six bridges, including multi-group and page-crossing ranges.
cmqttd_deviations: Reads exact parameter extents instead of N-byte blocks from each parameter start.
Does not halt a GIU during LOAD.
Reselects the page at the start of every paged STORE range and reads every range back after STORE.
Writes a whole changed parameter and numbers STORE tags from zero per parameter; native writes only changed bytes (except GOCBYT/GOC2) and merges adjacent same-class bytes into save-wide groups.
